messages:
ajay: Heads up — two customers reported billing being attributed to the org after yesterday's proxy change. Looks like project claim missing in the exchange path.
sofia: confirmed in traces. exchange returns project claim ~72% of the time on the new route; remaining requests are projectless and hit org fallback.
maria: do we have a small repro/log snippet?
ajay: redacted: [auth] exchange result: claims={} sub=svc-421 -> routing resolved_project=null fallback=org-14
sofia: old proxy would synthesize x-origin-project when claim missing. new gateway assumes exchange always sets project.
kai: important: synthesized values must never be used for authorization. If we infer a project for billing/telemetry, mark it telemetry-only and run privacy/legal review.
maria: proposal: auth-service emits an `effective_project` telemetry tag after exchange; the tag is used only for billing attribution heuristics and sampled events. Never store it in audit logs.
sofia: implementation sketch: effective_project = claims.get('project') or infer_from_token_meta(); if claim missing, emit sampled event `auth.fallback` with project_hint (5% sample). add metric `auth.fallback.count{reason="no_project"}`.
ajay: to avoid high-cardinality metrics, canonicalize project into cohorts for the aggregated metric; keep raw project_hint only in sampled payloads stored in event index.
maria: Console UX: show a faint "likely project" badge on billing rows with confidence percentage (only when confidence >= 60%). Add a "dry-run reassign" action for SEs which posts to a reconcile endpoint (dry-run first).
kai: gating: start at 5% sample -> 25% -> 100% only after privacy sign-off. Also require an auditable toggle for support to enable full attribution per-customer during triage.
sofia: tests: unit for sampler, e2e for exchange-missing-claims path to assert event emitted, integration test to ensure header preservation across gateway.
ajay: ops plan: deploy auth-service canary with sampler enabled for 5% traffic, monitor `auth.fallback.count` and billing drift. GH issue opened, tagging privacy and legal.
ops-bot: canary deployment scheduled: auth-service@canary -> routing-proxy@stable (5% traffic). CI green.
maria: I'll start the console PR and dashboard panel "Attribution anomalies" that surfaces sampled top candidates and confidence.
sofia: will send PR for auth-service change: add effective_project tag + sampler + debug toggle `auth.debug_full_attribution` (audited).
kai: starting privacy review now. Please include sample schema and retention details.
ajay: great. action items: 1) GH issue + privacy (ajay), 2) auth-service change (sofia), 3) sampler + metrics (sofia), 4) console badge + reconcile UI (maria), 5) canary + monitoring (ajay/ops). Ping infra-oncall if billing drift > 1.5% over 24h. :thumbsup:
